The latest evidence is more consistent with strong continuation entering a pause or pullback-risk window than with confirmed distribution. BTC and ETH retain substantial 12-hour to 72-hour gains and breadth remains broad in the available proxy, while the newest interval shows higher funding, BTC open-interest contraction, weaker ETH/BTC performance, negative BTC taker imbalance, extreme sentiment, and a decline in the 30-day rotation proxy. The evidence does not establish persistent deterioration or a structural breakdown. Both late-cycle failure modes remain live: a short-term pullback could occur while upside continuation remains substantial, and premature interpretation of hot sentiment or leverage as distribution would be unsupported. These are shadow interpretations and unratified forecast candidates only.
